reasoning: The claim that the Great Wall of China is the only man-made structure visible from space with the naked eye is a well-documented myth. According to NASA and reports from numerous astronauts (including China's own Yang Liwei), the Great Wall is virtually invisible to the naked eye from Low Earth Orbit (LEO) because it is narrow (generally less than 10 meters wide) and constructed of materials that closely match the color of the surrounding terrain. Conversely, other human-made structures, such as highways, airports, large dams, and cities (especially when illuminated at night), are visible from space.
